WHICH emulated device an attacker reached in order to stamp the right
Why that matters: those three fields seed the uuid5 of the x-ics-asset
node IronPot writes. One identity for every protocol would tell an
analyst that a BACnet write landed on the PLC that runs the plant. Before
H11 the roster was a pair of literals in the forwarder, which was correct
for exactly one persona; with --template it has to travel with the
template tree, because the forwarder and the persona ship to the sensor
together and nothing else pairs them.
asset_type must stay inside the enum in ironmonkey-unified/shared/
`services` keys are the forwarder's own data_type values (the ones it
branches on in _map_record), not port names. `default` covers every
service with no entry of its own.
